caseStudy.title: Design Token Pipeline
caseStudy.lead: An assessment of an enterprise design system that app teams in many countries build on, and a proposal for an automated token pipeline from Figma to Web, iOS and Android, with accessibility built in and a safe way to rename tokens.

brief.title: The brief
text: The group's design system is the default component library that country teams build their local apps on.
The task was to propose how design tokens could flow automatically from Figma to Web, iOS and Android, keep every platform in step and never break the apps that already depend on them.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Took part in the assessment as the mobile lead, for iOS and Android.
Designed the token pipeline from Figma to Web, iOS and Android, with CI checks and pull requests into the platform repos.
Defined accessibility rules for components and typed accessibility keys generated from Figma.
Proposed a migration path for renamed tokens and recommendations for CI/CD.

architecture.title: The proposed pipeline
architecture.text: One source of truth in Git. Every change is validated and arrives on each platform as a reviewable pull request.

team.title: Team
team.text: The assessment team: me on mobile, a web frontend developer, a Figma designer and the agency's Product Owner, working with the client's design and platform specialists.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The client accepted the assessment. Implementation stayed with the client's internal teams.

items.title: One source of truth
items.text: Tokens designed in Figma and stored in a Git repository, with a pinned Style Dictionary config, so every platform is generated from the same data.

items.title: Checked on every change
items.text: CI validates schema, naming and duplicates on each pull request before anything reaches an app.

items.title: Delivered as pull requests
items.text: On merge, Android, iOS and Web artifacts are generated and arrive as pull requests in the platform repositories, never as direct pushes.

items.title: Safe renames
items.text: A compatibility window with generated aliases and deprecations keeps apps working while tokens are renamed.

items.title: Language-agnostic accessibility
items.text: The library ships typed accessibility keys; apps resolve them to localised strings. Components keep one stable accessibility node.

items.title: A Kotlin Multiplatform variant
items.text: Tokens generated once for shared KMP code, for teams that build on it.
